tool_input.command: for f in resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx resources/js/pages/posts/Edit.tsx; do perl -0pi -e 's/>Title<\/label>/>{t(\x27posts.field_title\x27)}<\/label>/; s/>Excerpt<\/label>/>{t(\x27posts.field_excerpt\x27)}<\/label>/; s/>Body<\/label>/>{t(\x27posts.field_body\x27)}<\/label>/' "$f"; done; grep -n "label" resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx resources/js/pages/posts/Edit.tsx

result:
Japanese is now available alongside English, with a language switcher in the site header. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass, and so do the project's full `bunx guren gate` and `bunx guren check --i18n`. The catalog check reports the same 29 keys in `lang/en` and `lang/ja`, and no page or component contains a hard-coded 「記事」.

- **Detection:** the framework already reads a `locale` cookie before the browser's `Accept-Language` header, so the switcher only has to set that cookie. English stays the default.
- **Switching:** `POST /locale` is new. It is open to guests and signed-in users, accepts only `en` or `ja`, and stores the choice in the `locale` cookie for a year. It then redirects to the `Referer`, or to `/` when there isn't one. A bad or missing value gets the same 422 response as an invalid post title, and the cookie is left alone.
- **Off-site `Referer`:** to avoid sending people to another website, a `Referer` from another site only has its path kept, so `https://evil.example/posts` redirects to `/posts`.
- **Pages:** the header and the four posts pages (list, post, new, edit) now take all their text from the catalogs. I also added a "Home" link to `/` in the header, since the key table asked for one. Post dates on the post page are formatted for the current language.

**Changes, by file:**
- `src/app.ts`: supported languages are now `['en', 'ja']`.
- `app/Http/Validators/LocaleValidator.ts` (new): the rule that only allows `en` or `ja`.
- `app/Http/Controllers/LocaleController.ts` (new): the `POST /locale` handler.
- `routes/web.ts`: registers the route as `locale.update`.
- `lang/{en,ja}/`: `messages.json` (the Japanese welcome message) plus new `nav.json`, `auth.json`, `posts.json` and `locale.json`. The two folders have identical keys, including all nine from the table.
- `resources/js/components/Layout.tsx`: the header links, sign-in/log-out labels and the switcher.
- `resources/js/pages/posts/{Index,Show,New,Edit}.tsx`: text now comes from the catalogs.
- `.guren/*.gen.ts`: regenerated so the new keys are type-checked.
- `tests/LocaleController.test.ts` (new): covers the cookie, the `Referer` and `/` redirects, the off-site redirect, the 422 cases, and the `_i18n` language with the cookie, with `Accept-Language`, and with the pick winning over the browser.
